rows.detail_main_html:
Blindside

Also recorded as Blindside I

Rogue · Level 10 · Intercept

Effect

You quickly strike at the attacker of your defensive target, dealing 300% weapon damage plus 45 to 51 and causing your next melee attack to critically hit.

Alternate description

A second source words this differently; both are kept rather than one being discarded.

Intercept melee attack which causes your next attack to crit

As it was earlier
